test(apk-0232 r2): N1 latch at the local turn, N2 the held IDR in Codex's order

- client_session_prelogin_select_test P8 (REMOTE60_CLIENT_SESSION_TEST_HOOKS, this target only): queued A held just
  after its sink turn, the user prepares and picks B meanwhile, A resumes -> B, by its own IDR, shows selected with its
  generation; A cancelled alone completes nothing. 46/46. Mutant N1 (no lock, the panel's answer ignored) -> P8 FAIL.
- decoder_pending_slot_test (the product slot + gate, a codec stand-in): G held, its retries fail, H arrives with a
  buffer free -> only H reaches the codec, bound to H; a frame held from before a pick is not queued while the answer
  is awaited; a delta never overtakes a held IDR. 10/10. Mutant N2 (r1 shape) -> 7 FAIL ("200 100": G after H).
